title: Sparkly croissant
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Croissant body: crescent with segments -->
  <!-- main crescent shape -->
  <path d='M18 62 Q14 40 30 30 Q50 20 70 30 Q86 40 82 62 Q78 76 62 74 Q50 72 50 60 Q50 72 38 74 Q22 76 18 62 Z' fill='#E8A33D'/>
  <!-- lighter top highlight crescent -->
  <path d='M20 58 Q18 40 32 32 Q50 23 68 32 Q82 40 80 58 Q79 66 70 66 Q58 66 54 56 Q52 66 42 66 Q31 66 26 60 Z' fill='#F5C46B'/>
  <!-- segment ridges (curved darker golden lines) -->
  <path d='M30 34 Q34 46 28 60' stroke='#C47E22' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M42 29 Q42 44 38 62' stroke='#C47E22' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M56 29 Q56 44 60 62' stroke='#C47E22' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M68 34 Q66 46 72 60' stroke='#C47E22' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- center tip of crescent (the little end fold) -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#F5C46B'/>
  <path d='M43 68 Q50 63 57 68' stroke='#C47E22' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- sparkles around -->
  <g fill='#FFE86B'>
    <!-- four-point sparkle top-left -->
    <path d='M20 14 L22 22 L30 24 L22 26 L20 34 L18 26 L10 24 L18 22 Z'/>
    <!-- sparkle top-right -->
    <path d='M80 12 L82 19 L89 21 L82 23 L80 30 L78 23 L71 21 L78 19 Z'/>
    <!-- small sparkle left -->
    <path d='M10 44 L11 49 L16 50 L11 51 L10 56 L9 51 L4 50 L9 49 Z'/>
    <!-- small sparkle right -->
    <path d='M90 46 L91 51 L96 52 L91 53 L90 58 L89 53 L84 52 L89 51 Z'/>
    <!-- sparkle bottom -->
    <path d='M50 84 L52 89 L57 90 L52 91 L50 96 L48 91 L43 90 L48 89 Z'/>
  </g>
  <!-- tiny diamond sparkles -->
  <g fill='#FFF6B8'>
    <rect x='33' y='12' width='4' height='4' transform='rotate(45 35 14)'/>
    <rect x='67' y='14' width='3' height='3' transform='rotate(45 68.5 15.5)'/>
    <rect x='72' y='82' width='4' height='4' transform='rotate(45 74 84)'/>
    <rect x='22' y='78' width='3' height='3' transform='rotate(45 23.5 79.5)'/>
  </g>
</svg>
